title: 7 Day Botswana Family Camping Safari: Moremi, Khwai and Savuti

rank_math_desc: 7 day Botswana family camping safari: a mobile camp in Moremi, Khwai and Savuti, campfire meals by a camp chef and game drives for families with older children.
post_content: This 7 day Botswana family camping safari is an adventure for families with older children.
overview:
This 7 day Botswana family camping safari is an adventure for families with older children. A crew sets up camp in Moremi, the Khwai Concession and Savuti, a camp chef cooks every meal, and you spend the days on game drives looking for elephants, lions, leopards and wild dogs.

Why is this 7 day Botswana family camping safari special for children?

Sleeping in the wild, eating around the campfire and hearing lions at night make this a safari children remember. The crew sets up and packs down the camp, so families can relax between game drives.

Botswana's parks are unfenced and remote, so most camping safaris suit children aged around 8 and over. Tell us your children's ages and we will confirm the right plan.

What does the family itinerary include?

Two nights camping in Moremi Game Reserve, two in the Khwai Concession and two in Savuti, starting in Maun and ending at Maun or Kasane airport.

What is the camping like?

Your crew sets up dome tents with bedding, a dining area and camp toilets and showers. Meals are freshly cooked by the chef and served around the fire.

Read our Botswana safari guide and best time to visit Botswana.

How do group bookings work?

For every six paying travellers, the seventh place is free. Each traveller can pay separately, and people can arrive on different flights. A deposit of 30 to 40% holds the booking and the balance is due 2 to 4 weeks before travel. Full payment and cancellation rules are in our terms and conditions.

Can several families share the 7 day Botswana family camping safari?

Yes. Camping suits groups of families well because the whole camp is yours. Larger groups travel in two vehicles with extra crew, and each family can pay separately.

How do I get a group quote?

Price on request. Group prices depend on your dates, the number of travellers and the rooms you need, so we quote every group personally. WhatsApp us on +254 706 223888, email bookings@divulgeadventures.com, use our group safari inquiry form or request a tailor-made quote. Read more about family safaris.

faq.q: What age is the 7 day Botswana family camping safari suitable for?
faq.a: The 7 day Botswana family camping safari usually suits children aged around 8 and over, because the camps are unfenced and remote. We confirm age rules for your dates and can suggest lodge-based options for younger children.

faq.q: Is camping in Botswana safe for families?
faq.a: Yes, with an experienced crew. Guides brief everyone on camp rules, such as staying in the tent at night and walking with a guide after dark.
Our crew sets up and packs down the tents, the dining area and the bathroom facilities, and the camp chef prepares all meals.
Yes. On group bookings the seventh place is free for every six paying travellers, and each family can pay separately.

faq.q: When is the best time for a Botswana family camping safari?
faq.a: June to October is dry and cooler, with the best game viewing and fewer insects. These months also match northern school holidays.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Maun to Moremi Game Reserve
itinerary.content: Meet your guide at Maun airport and stop in town for any last-minute supplies. Drive through Shorobe Village to Moremi Game Reserve, with game viewing on the way. The crew sets up camp while you freshen up, then head out on your first afternoon game drive.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Moremi Game Reserve
itinerary.content: Morning and afternoon game drives through Moremi's varied habitats, with a rest at camp during the hottest part of the day. Meals are cooked by the camp chef and served around the fire.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Moremi to the Khwai Concession
itinerary.content: Break camp after breakfast and drive to the Khwai Concession, with game viewing along the way. After lunch at the new camp, take an afternoon game drive.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Khwai Concession
itinerary.content: Morning and afternoon game drives in Khwai, known for elephants, lions, leopards, wild dogs and buffalo.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Khwai to Savuti
itinerary.content: Drive to Savuti with a picnic lunch on the way. The crew sets up camp while you relax, then head out on an afternoon game drive.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Savuti
itinerary.content: Morning and afternoon game drives in Savuti, famous for its elephant herds, lion prides and hyenas.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.content: A final game drive on the way to Maun or Kasane airport for your onward journey.
